visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a young woman with tanned skin and brown hair pulled back. She wears a black top with a scalloped collar and a black strap around her neck. She speaks directly into the camera with a subtle smile against a background of distressed colorful wooden panels in red, blue, and yellow. (2) The scene shifts to a wide selfie angle inside a skydiving facility. The woman is wearing a blue and yellow skydiving jumpsuit with "WELAND" printed on it and a striped headband. She walks past blue walls decorated with a heart-shaped photo collage and several clothing racks holding gear. (3) The woman is now seated inside the cabin of a small white airplane. She is equipped with a black helmet and clear skydiving goggles over her jumpsuit. Two other individuals in full skydiving equipment are visible in the cramped interior, sitting near an open jump door. (4) A dramatic shot shows the woman jumping out of the airplane into the open sky. The aircraft is blue and white with visible registration numbers. She maintains a stable, belly-down posture as she exits, surrounded by vast white clouds and a brilliant blue sky at high altitude. (5) The final phase consists of several aerial views of the woman free-falling. Below her, the massive palm-tree-shaped artificial islands of Dubai are clearly visible in the turquoise ocean. The camera captures her joy and the immense scale of the landscape as she descends through the atmosphere.
